kit.cover_letter: I am writing to express my interest in the Software Engineer Intern position at Coinbase India Services. As an MCA student at PES University with hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to apply my technical skills to build scalable software systems. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which was taken live for real customer bookings and featured role-based access control. Additionally, as a freelance full-stack developer, I delivered a POS system using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server deployed on Azure, ensuring reliable daily transaction handling. In my personal projects, such as Zenvest, I built a multi-service trading platform utilizing an Express API, JWT authentication, and Joi-based request validation. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to solve complex technical problems and contribute to your engineering team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my backend and full-stack development experience aligns with your needs.

screening_answers.why_this_company: Coinbase is building the next generation of crypto-forward products and features, presenting unique, large-scale, and highly complex technical problems to solve.
screening_answers.why_this_role: This role aligns directly with my background in backend and full-stack development, utilizing my experience with Node.js, Express, databases like MySQL and MongoDB, and building production-ready web applications.
screening_answers.why_you: I bring hands-on full-stack engineering experience from my internship at Sunflower Trip where I built a live production system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, alongside freelance experience delivering a digital POS system deployed on Azure. I also have strong foundational academic credentials as an MCA student at PES University with a CGPA of 8.48.
